title: Misregistered print shop
technique: A 3D object lit by red, green and blue lights is split into spot-colour plates, each screened into dots, lines or grain and overprinted out of register on moving paper.
music: Kick, snare and hi-hat each re-expose their own plate and knock it out of register before it springs back, while the bass swells the dots and lines. The paper advances on the beat or the bar, and each new section of the song changes the object, the words and the inks.
as_processor: Prints the picture as a colour separation: its red, green and blue channels become three ink plates (dark areas take the most ink), each screened into dots, lines, rings or hatching and overprinted out of register on paper, with each plate re-exposed on its own drum hit.

takes.name: Proof
takes.description: One printed sheet nearly fills the frame, with the object on the right, a huge cropped yellow word, and printer's marks around the edge.
words: A 3D MODEL UNDER RED, GREEN AND BLUE LIGHTS. EACH LIGHT PRINTS AS ONE PLATE OF INK.

takes.name: Loupe
takes.description: An extreme close-up of the print screens, showing giant dots, lines and grain with colour fringes where the plates miss each other, and no readable word.

takes.name: Delivery
takes.description: Seen from high above, lanes of small sheets run in opposite directions, with a new sheet every beat and each sheet in its own colours.

takes.name: Duotone
takes.description: Just two inks, red and blue, printed as line screens that cross into a moire pattern on pink paper, with the object seen from above and the print running to the edges.
words: 2 INKS, 2 LINE SCREENS RED AT 32 DEG, BLUE AT -28 WHERE THEY CROSS: MOIRE

takes.name: Type
takes.description: No object at all: rows of phrases in pink and teal slide past each other over a coarse yellow disc and a striped fragment of a big word.
words: SAME WORDS ON TWO INK PLATES.
ONE PRINTS SOLID, ONE AS GRAIN.
A KICK KNOCKS THE SOLID PLATE.
A SNARE KNOCKS THE GRAIN PLATE.
EACH BAR A ROLLER PRINTS AGAIN.
THE DISC IS A PLATE OF BIG DOTS.
THE STRIPES ARE ONE HUGE WORD.

takes.name: Corner
takes.description: The bottom-left corner of a poster, with a sun made of coarse dots, a tiny object, and the register crosses and colour bar large in the frame.
words: REGISTER CROSSES AND COLOUR BAR: EACH INK PLATE PRINTS ITS OWN. A DRUM HIT SPLITS THEM APART.

takes.name: Night
takes.description: Opaque white, pink and yellow inks on dark navy paper, printed where the light falls instead of in the shade, with a white outlined word.
words: OPAQUE WHITE, PINK AND YELLOW PRINT WHERE THE LIGHT FALLS.

takes.name: Makeready
takes.description: A waste sheet lying upside down on brown paper, where every plate carries the object at a different size and angle.
words: EVERY PLATE HOLDS THE MODEL AT ITS OWN SIZE AND ANGLE.

takes.name: Gang sheet
takes.description: The artwork is repeated in a grid of four by three on one sheet, each tile printed with its own mix of inks.

takes.name: Pile
takes.description: On every beat a finished sheet is slapped onto a heap on a brown table, each landing at its own angle.

takes.name: Conveyor
takes.description: A low, tilted view down the press bed, with lanes of sheets stepping toward and away from the camera each beat and fading into haze.

takes.name: Bond
takes.description: Banknote-style printing on green-grey paper, where wavy engraved lines draw the object and a big word over a faint pink ring pattern.
words: LINE WIDTH CARRIES THE TONE AS ON A BANKNOTE

takes.name: Xerox
takes.description: A black-and-white photocopy look with a cross-hatched object, a big typewriter-style word and heavy streaks, where every second copy is a negative.
words: BLACK INK ONLY, CROSS-HATCHED EVERY 2ND COPY IS A NEGATIVE

takes.name: Target
takes.description: Orange and blue screens made of concentric rings with different centres overlap into bullseye moire on yellow paper, with the object enlarged.
words: RING SCREENS: 2 INKS, 2 CENTRES WHERE RINGS CROSS: BULLSEYE MOIRE
